findings.text: The landing fragment states the second skip is 'pre-existing in the catalog-layout file', but both gate logs show the two skips in test_cascade_calibration.py and test_compose_prompt_examples_round_trip.py (the vocab-gap pytest.skip at line 113) and none in test_catalog_layout_hierarchy.py; a reader checking the fragment against the logs finds a claim the logs refute.

The after_suite object carries only revision, command, exit_status and log_path; it omits completed, failure_count and failure_ids, which the arm contract treats as unreadable, so a promotion reading the structured field rather than head-arm.log cannot tell the head arm ran to its summary line (276 passed, 2 skipped, EXIT=0).
